info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, Ypos, mapXPos, loopX, bolt, COPTER, cableGuy, ouchCount, prevBolt, boltOffset, loopWidthglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gDamagePercenton beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  bolt = sprite(the currentSpriteNum - 1)  COPTER = sprite(4)  cableGuy = sprite(6)  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  this.locZ = 51  bolt.locZ = 52  mapXPos = Xpos - 256  loopX = (gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.25) - Xpos  ouchCount = 0  prevBolt = 0  boltOffset = -50endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    this.locH = Xpos    this.locV = Ypos    boltTarget = cableGuy    xDiff = this.locH - boltTarget.locH    if abs(xDiff) < 120 then      yDiff = this.locV - boltTarget.locV      if yDiff < 168 then        rand = random(2)        if rand = 1 then          boltTarget = cableGuy        else          boltTarget = COPTER        end if        boltOffset = 96 - (random(3) * 48)        bolt.locH = this.locH + boltOffset        bolt.locV = this.locV        bolt.rotation = AngleGrind(bolt.locH, bolt.locV, boltTarget.locH, boltTarget.locV) + 90        xDiff = bolt.locH - boltTarget.locH        yDiff = bolt.locV - boltTarget.locV        bolt.height = sqrt((xDiff * xDiff) + (yDiff * yDiff))        if prevBolt = 0 then          prevBolt = 1          puppetSound(3, member(38, "Sfx"))        end if        gDamagePercent = gDamagePercent + 0.5        if soundBusy(4) = 0 then          puppetSound(4, member(34 + ouchCount, "Sfx"))          ouchCount = ouchCount + 1          if ouchCount > 3 then            ouchCount = 0          end if        end if      else        if prevBolt = 1 then          prevBolt = 0          puppetSound(3, 0)        end if        bolt.locH = -1000        bolt.locV = -1000      end if    else      if prevBolt = 1 then        prevBolt = 0        puppetSound(3, 0)      end if      bolt.locH = -1000      bolt.locV = -1000    end if  end ifend
